description: This file defines an abstract PHP class `LocationItem` within the `Goteo` project. The class provides a base implementation for location-related models, including methods for creating, retrieving, validating, saving, and querying geographic location data, as well as handling different location types. It also maintains a static list of location type mappings to other location models in the project.

classes.name: LocationItem
classes.description: An abstract class that models location items, providing basic CRUD operations, type management, and geographic queries. It implements the LocationInterface and extends the core Model class.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of a specific location type class based on provided type string and arguments. Ensures the class implements LocationInterface.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a location instance from the database by ID.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns the static array of available location types.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with a given location type key.

methods.name: addType
methods.description: Adds a new location type mapping to the static types array.

methods.name: delType
methods.description: Removes a location type from the static array.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Returns the full class name of the model associated with this location type.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the model instance associated with this location.

methods.name: createByIp
methods.description: Creates a Location instance based on IP geolocation data using MaxMind database.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates essential properties of the location object, such as ID, country, coordinates, and method.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the location object to the database after validation.

methods.name: getFormatted
methods.description: Returns a human-readable formatted string of the location.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value on the location, updating the database.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the location object.

methods.name: setUnlocable
methods.description: Marks a location as unlocable (not editable/visible).

methods.name: isUnlocable
methods.description: Checks if a location is marked as unlocable.

methods.name: getSibilingsNearby
methods.description: Returns locations ordered by proximity within a certain radius.

methods.name: getNearby
methods.description: Static method that performs a spatial query to find nearby locations using the spherical law of cosines.
